AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

Pre-approved admin changes (standing approvals); G5 backups and archive tags first. None of this waits on the release-path work.

- Branches: gh-readonly-queue/* with no queued entry and no workflow run referencing the SHA (the merge queue was retired in #2582); auto-revert/* after closing their PRs (archive tags first); auto/* whose PRs are closed; fix/*, claude/*, feat/*, docs/*, chore/* whose PRs are merged or closed. Never delete develop, published-results, todo-state, release, publication, v*, or any branch with an open PR.
- Labels: delete incident:develop-red and incident:develop-red-revert-conflict (repo-admin-settings.md:645 says nothing uses them).
- Secrets: delete TODO_DB_URL, TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN and TODO_EXPORT_PR_TOKEN. No workflow consumes them (todo-state-validate.yml is asserted credential-free by tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_state_workflow.py). Fix the stale docs in the same change: docs/operations/todo-db-benchbox-extraction.md:125-131 (and the check at :164-165), docs/operations/hosted-credentials.md, and docs/operations/github-org-transfer.md:48 and :103.

Keep the labels awaiting-owner, incident:todo-export-failed, nightly-quarantine and t3:*, and the secrets CODECOV_TOKEN (D6) and RULESET_DRIFT_TOKEN (D7).
